audit.why: 55.07% over 1451 games — the second-best matchup in this slice, and the survive-then-flip shape the prose uses is right. Pantheon's damage is front-loaded into Comet Spear and Shield Vault while Malphite's scales with armour, and Pantheon has no percent-health or true damage anywhere in his kit to break a tank later.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.win reads Skill, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Skill, Pantheon, Pantheon — it hands Pantheon the first item and two-item stages, while the page's own text calls first item 'your power peak' and says late 'you become an unkillable frontline he can't crack'.
audit.why: This is the most flatly self-contradicting chart in the slice: a 55.07% matchup whose chart says Malphite never wins a single stage, on a page that argues he wins every stage after 6. The packet levelChart is Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Malphite, Malphite, Malphite, which matches both the prose and the win rate. Enum cells cannot pass the length band, so it is recorded here.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early says 'his passive blocks one of your autos', whys[1] says 'his passive blocks your auto', and wants.foe[1] says 'Use his passive auto-block to win extended early trades'.
audit.why: Mortal Will does not block anything — Riot's text is 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' The blocking ability is Aegis Assault (E), which sets his shield and makes him invulnerable to damage from the FRONT for a channel, on 22/21/20/19/18. Three consequences the old text destroys: the block is directional, so it can be walked around; it is a channel, so a knock-up ends it; and it is the longest cooldown in the matchup, so it defines when Malphite is allowed to commit. Calling it a passive removes all three.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault (E), 22/21/20/19/18, blocks damage from the front only and is a channel. Mortal Will just empowers his next spell.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid justifies the level 6 all-in with 'his W stun can't stop an unstoppable dash'.
audit.why: Nothing in the kit files establishes what Shield Vault's stun does to an in-flight Unstoppable Force, and needsResearch is empty by design rather than because the answer is known. I replaced the unverifiable claim with two things that are in Riot's text and matter more: Aegis Assault is frontal-only, so R past him and hit from behind, and it is a channel, which a knock-up ends.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault blocks the front only and is a channel — knock him out of it and finish from behind.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and it is accurate — breakdown.cooldowns said only 'Pantheon Shield Vault: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Respect it.'
audit.why: Aegis Assault at 22/21/20/19/18 is the longest cooldown either champion has in lane, longer than any of Malphite's basic abilities by a factor of three. Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9 and Comet Spear 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8. Once those numbers are on the page the 'survive then flip' plan becomes a countable schedule instead of a mood.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18; Shield Vault 13/12/11/10/9; Comet Spear 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8; Grand Starfall 180/165/150.

audit.why: The packet's suspectName 'Ground Slam's' in content.mid is a FALSE POSITIVE — it is the correct Riot name for Malphite's E with a possessive attached. No change made on that basis.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grand Starfall's 5500 range and 180s cooldown appear nowhere, though content.late tells the player to watch his roams.
audit.why: A 5500-range global on 180/165/150 is the longest cooldown in the matchup and the reason a won lane can still lose the map. Naming the number turns 'ping his roams' into a thing the player can time from the moment they see it used.
audit.corrected: Grand Starfall reaches 5500 on 180/165/150 — when he spends it, the map is safe for three minutes.

edits.before: Pantheon owns these levels outright and you just have to survive them — his empowered Q spear hits like a truck, his W is a point-click stun that sets up free poke, and his passive blocks one of your autos so you can't even trade back. Don't walk up to throw a Q he can stun-cancel into a spear; last-hit at max Q range, let Granite Shield soak the chip, and disengage so the shield refreshes. You have no Level 1-3 trade pattern against him, so concede the wave and farm.
edits.after: Pantheon owns these levels and you survive them — Comet Spear hits like a truck, Shield Vault (W, 13s at rank 1) is a point-click dash-stun that sets up free poke, and Aegis Assault (E, 22s at rank 1) makes him invulnerable to damage from the front while he stabs. That is his block, not his passive: Mortal Will only empowers his next spell. Last-hit at max Q range, let Granite Shield soak the chip, disengage so it refreshes, and concede the wave here.

edits.before: This is where it swings back to you. At 4-5 your Thunderclap gives bonus armor and AoE splash autos while Ground Slam's attack-speed slow and Granite Shield let you finally farm through his spear instead of bleeding. Level 6 is the flip — Unstoppable Force knocks him up, and his W stun can't stop an unstoppable dash. R in, Thunderclap-empowered autos, Ground Slam, and he doesn't have the durability to survive your all-in once you've stacked even one armor item.
edits.after: This is where it swings back. At 4-5 Thunderclap gives armour and splash autos while Ground Slam's attack-speed cut and Granite Shield let you farm through his spear. Level 6 is the flip, and the geometry matters: Aegis Assault only blocks damage from the FRONT and it is a channel, so land Unstoppable Force to knock him out of it, then Thunderclap autos and Ground Slam from behind him. He has no durability to survive that once one armour item is on you.

notes: Both packet defects were real. Pantheon's abilities were entirely unnamed, and there was no sequencing anywhere. The important correction is that Pantheon's block is Aegis Assault, not his passive: it is directional (front only), it is a channel a knock-up ends, and at 22s rank 1 it is the longest lane cooldown in the matchup — three pieces of counterplay that the words 'his passive blocks an auto' delete outright. Mortal Will only empowers his next spell. One claim I removed rather than kept: 'his W stun can't stop an unstoppable dash' is not supported by anything in either kit file, so it is replaced with the frontal-block geometry instead. Chart: this is the worst offender in the slice — a 55.07% matchup whose win array gives Malphite nothing at any stage while the same page calls first item his power peak. Target is Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Malphite, Malphite, Malphite.
